text_block_list.name: Chieru
text_block_list.text: There were plenty of food stalls at St. Theresa's Fes.
text_block_list.orig_text: テレフェスには模擬店もいっぱい出てましたね。

text_block_list.name: Yuni
text_block_list.text: The Pure Team side was a hotbed of irregularities. But in the end, the guests seemed to remember it well, but that's only natural.
text_block_list.orig_text:
「きよらか」側は不正の温床だったがな。
結果として
来賓の覚えは高かったようだが、
そりゃあそうだろうとしか言いようがない。

text_block_list.name: Chieru
text_block_list.text: No, no, even the Refined Team's booth, despite being amateur, didn't lose! Like Chloe-senpai's tsundere maid café!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いえいえ
「しとやか」の模擬店だって、
素人ながら負けちゃいませんでしたよ？
クロエ先輩のツンデレメイドカフェとか！

text_block_list.name: Chieru
text_block_list.text: Well... nothing really left a strong impression, but...
text_block_list.orig_text:
他には……
ま、
とくに印象に残ってないですけども。

text_block_list.name: Yuni
text_block_list.text: Oh my, they're saying whatever they want... let's just assume Chloe-kun is backing out of next year's St. Theresa's Fes.
text_block_list.orig_text:
やれやれ、
来年はすべての店にクロエ君を派遣するか。

text_block_list.name: Chieru
text_block_list.text: That's a great idea! This year was all about cute miniskirts and short sleeves, but next year, we'll put you in a chic and classical orthodox maid outfit!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いいですね！
今年は半袖ミニスカのキュート全振りバージョンでしたけど、
来年はシックでクラシカルな正統派メイド服を着せましょう！

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text: What the heck are they talking about... Well, for now, it's confirmed that they'll back out of next year's St. Theresa's Fes.
text_block_list.orig_text:
なに勝手なこと言ってんだあいつら……
とりま来年のテレフェスはバックレ確定だな。
